policies.name: league_events_member_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM league_members member
  WHERE ((member.league_id = league_events.league_id) AND (member.user_id = auth.uid()) AND ((league_events.kind <> 'claim.failed'::text) OR (member.id = league_events.member_id)) AND ((league_events.kind <> ALL (ARRAY['trade.sent'::text, 'trade.countered'::text, 'trade.edited'::text, 'trade.accepted'::text, 'trade.failed'::text, 'trade.rejected'::text, 'trade.withdrawn'::text, 'trade.expired'::text])) OR ((league_events.detail -> 'member_ids'::text) ? (member.id)::text) OR ((member.id)::text = ANY (ARRAY[(league_events.detail ->> 'proposer_member_id'::text), (league_events.detail ->> 'recipient_member_id'::text)]))))))

triggers.name: compact_change_delete
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER compact_change_delete AFTER DELETE ON public.roster_players REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION private.emit_league_change()
